headline: As of 2026-09-30: 550,544 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 24 of 50 states, D+42.9 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 550,544 early/mail ballots cast so far across 24 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+42.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (220,969), New Jersey (99,389), Wisconsin (51,538).
